source_title: Kuvings Introduces AUTO10 SQUARE™ Plus, Bringing Effortless Hands-Free Juicing to Modern Kitchens
source_excerpt:
Advanced cold-press technology meets space-saving design with expandable capacity for healthier living.

Powered by a 240W BLACKHAWKÂ® high-torque motor, the AUTO10 SQUARE Plus delivers reliable, low-speed juicing performance at 60 RPM, even when processing large batches of ingredients. Its three-in-one functionality also lets consumers prepare homemade plant-based milks and frozen sorbets.
